# XML FOMOD fixture

ModuleConfig.xml is a project-authored synthetic installer. It covers required files, wrapper roots,
variant folders, flags, step visibility, a conditional option type, conditional files, priorities and
alwaysInstall/installIfUsable. Test payloads are generated in temporary directories by the tests.
No third-party mod assets or installer implementation are included. The fixture is dedicated to the
public domain under CC0 1.0. Tests never execute its payloads.
